title: A Little Jazzy Feel
style: Light, warm swinging vocal jazz at 132 BPM. Female vocalist Jazz with gentle, positive, and reassuring delivery. Uplifting lyrics about how you just need a little jazzy feel when life feels heavy. Playful but tasteful scat in the break. Warm piano, light upright bass, swinging drums, subtle horns. Feel-good, comforting, and hopeful jazz production with modern warmth.
lyrics:
Full Lyrics
[Intro – Jazz, warm and inviting]
Mmm… yeah…
When it all feels too much…
You just need a little jazzy feel…
[Verse 1 – Jazz]
Day got you down, got you feeling low
Everything moving fast, moving way too slow
Head full of noise, heart feeling tight
Close your eyes for a minute… let the music make it right
[Pre-Chorus]
Don’t need much, just a little change of pace
A little rhythm, a little soul, a little grace
[Chorus – Jazz]
You just need a little jazzy feel
Let the music spin the wheel
A little swing in your step, a little scat in your soul
You just need a little jazzy feel… and you’ll be whole
Bee boo bop… jazzy feel
Scat scat cat… makes it real
[Verse 2 – Jazz]
Love got complicated, work got you stressed
Future looking foggy, can’t catch your breath
Put on a record, or just hum a tune
Watch how quick the heavy starts to leave the room
[Chorus]
You just need a little jazzy feel
Let the music spin the wheel
Doesn’t matter what you’re going through
A little jazz can always see you through
[Scat Break – Jazz, light and joyful]
Doo-bee-doo… wah-wah…
Bop-bee… scat-scat…
Jazzy feel… jazzy feel…
Bee-boo-bop… let it heal…
[Bridge – Jazz]
It’s not about fixing everything at once
Sometimes you just need a little music and a little trust
A little groove, a little grace
A little jazz can put a smile back on your face
[Final Chorus – Warm and full]
You just need a little jazzy feel
Let the music spin the wheel
Highs or lows, fast or slow
You just need a little jazzy feel… and let it flow
[Outro – Jazz, soft and reassuring]
You just need…
A little jazzy feel…
Bee boo bop… dop dop stop
